verdict.rationale: macOS ships its own programmatic surfaces: Shortcuts for automating tasks (macos-docs-19) and built-in command-line tools users rely on, such as pbcopy/pbpaste, qlmanage, hidutil and networkQuality (macos-comm-13 to 16). The evidence shows only scattered automation points, not that UI actions are broadly reachable programmatically. missing for 10: any evidence of UI-to-API parity, documented system-wide scripting/automation APIs (e.g. scripting dictionaries or accessibility automation), coverage of system settings and app actions via API, and independent corroboration of parity.
